title: Cosmic Foundry

selected_categories.reasoning: The main loop is repetitive low-friction input around starting the game, opening a shop, and making purchases that accelerate resource growth in a casual incremental format.
Credits are the primary resource, and the entire progression structure revolves around earning more money and buying upgrades that multiply earning power.
The game is a close fit for cash-growth clicker design even though the theme is cosmic rather than business-oriented; the feedback loop is still spend money to make more money.
There is no explicit narrative, but there is a sense of implied progression from asteroid-scale beginnings to universe-scale ownership that resembles a lightweight incremental arc.
The game lightly overlaps with meta progression concepts because the pleasure comes from abstract system growth and collection display rather than moment-to-moment challenge.

uncertainty_notes: The category universe does not include a direct 'idle game' or 'incremental game' label, so the closest clicker and money-growth labels were selected.
The game has almost no direct tapping-to-earn mechanic, so 'Clicker game' is a taxonomy compromise rather than a perfect descriptor.
The fourth and fifth entries are comparatively weak because the available category universe is broader than the actual game's focused mechanic set.
